KIRA-S01.title: Cathius Akarian
paragraphs: Name: Cathius Akarian “The Revered OneRace: AkarianAge: 75 (midlife on the dot) Appearance: Dark brown hair in long braids all over his head. Dark brown beard in a braid. 5’0. 225 pounds. Very muscular.Political Affiliation: Akarian Empire (Emperor)Faction/Guild: N/AAreas of Expertise: Two Handed weapons. GunsEquipment: Mithral Great Axe. Two Steel Hand cannonsSpells: None as Dwarves cannot use magic Backstory: Cathius was born in 1267, 75 years before present day to the Emperor and the Empress. He lives to watch the squabbles of the humans and elves and did not wish to see his people fall to such barbarism again. He began working at 15 years old to ensure the people were happy and had what they needed. At 20 he was the Revered One and had the love of the people. During a patrol in the over empire (Above ground part of the empire) he discovered the Bracatis or Battle Rams in the new tongue and after proposing the idea of using them as mounts to his father and the military command he was commemorated and given the mission of taming the first one. He found the largest Battle Ram he could and began the long painful job of subjugating it. After four long months Malachi was tamed and the military began the forming of the mounted division. At 35 his mother died and his father receded into the shadows of the throne room with depression. Cathius took over the duties of ruling the empire keeping it from collapsing without a ruler. The empire grew in strength, rebuilding after the war with the Elves and Humans. Cathius was 50 years old when his father died of natural causes after years in solitary. He was coroneted as Emperor Cathius Akarian the loved and began seeking trade deals with the other nations, the first was signed with the Southern half of the Estrusian Protectorate giving them guns and weapons in return for rare materials found only in their lands.Personality: Unusually calm for a dwarf. Stern and caring. Recognizes the mistakes of his ancestors, seeks to expand the empire underground rather than above.Mount: Bracatis (Battle Ram) named Malachi

KIRA-S02.title: Daniel Conver
paragraphs: Name: Daniel "Dan/Fox" Convor
Race: Sadire
Age: 24
Gender: Male

Appearance: Light brown hair. Green eyesHeight: 5’11Weight: 213LbsPolitical affiliation: Supports SadionGuild affiliation: Sergeant in the Legion of ValianceSpells: N/AEquipment: Hooded Leather Legion armor, Two Bronze Sabers, family amulet, 10 Iron throwing knives, Iron MachetePersonality: He's the of guy that would be joking in a crisis, Flirty, Brave, Kind, Loyal, Honest, ChivalrousBio: Fox was an orphan that grew up on the cold streets of Griffin. He got the nickname Fox from the group of people that "adopted" him. By adopted I mean raised him to steal from anyone that looked rich and weak. He did this until he was 13. At 13 he began robbing banks with a couple of other kids he had met. By age 15 he had robbed 20 banks and had a total of 200,000 gold. Bank robbing wasn't a challenge for him anymore so he joined the largest group of raiders in the country. They taught him how to use a weapons and how to fight. He soon became a master with his two blades and his machete. He ran with the group until he was 20. When he was 20 half of the raiders including himself were killed or captured. They offered Fox and anyone else 20 or younger two options. One: go to prison for life. Or two: join the army. He obviously joined the army. He was put into Dole Company under the command of Captain Dellin. He kept a clean record in the army because he knew that the military police were much more brutal than the regular police. When he was 24 Dole Company was called into action to hold an outpost against a group of 200 raiders. Fox quickly found out that the raiders were the one's that he used to run with. In the battle his Captain was killed and so were many of the officers. The raiders made one final push on the outpost but were wiped out. Fox killed the leader of the raiders and his top lieutenants. He was promoted to Corporal after the battle. Dole Company is currently under command of Lieutenant Dougrous Bottlebrewer and Captain Tiberious.During a training activity Captain Tiberious was struck by a random ass lightening bolt killing him killing him. This incident saw Doug promoted to Captain, Eagle promoted to Lieutenant, and Fox promoted to sergeant. Shortly after this while the company was out Eagle went for a ride to a nearby village where he found a near dead girl who was killed and resulted in his injury. He ran to the camp, all thirty-three miles where Fox found him. Fox gathered his gear and mounted his horse and rode hard for Glimfallow. Here he was directed to join a hunting party tracking the killer and soon he caught up and inflicted a nonfatal cut to the leg before bare knuckle boxing the man. He took the man back to camp where after interrogation and anger he was unnerved in the discovery that the man was part of the group he used to run with… John. After a long argument and beating Fox used a shovel to separate Johns head from the rest of his body. Eagle and Fox grew close in the incident strengthening them. His infatuation with Vera has seen him stay close to her in battle to ensure her protection.

KIRA-S03.title: Kieran Pelleas
paragraphs: Name: Kieran Pelleas
Race: Plains Elf
Appearance: Snow white hair, slightly tanned skin, 7’9, lean muscular build, extremely pointed ears
Political Affiliation: -Mercenary-
Faction/Guild: Rangers of Larius

Areas of Expertise: Master Dual Wield, Master bows, Expert One-Hand, Master Stealth, Expert Lock-Picking, Attuned Dispelling, Learned Runecrafting, Master Fletcher, Master Leatherworking, Learned Enchanting, and Learned Alchemy.

Equipment: Two identical sabers made of steel, a bow made of wood from the Evalian forest, Leather outfit and boots with Mithral pauldrons, greaves, and bracers, leather belt with 2 Engraved Iron daggers and 2 pouches with some herbs, cloth cloak lined with fur at the neck, lower face cloth mask, 50 Evalian wood arrows.

Spells: Lesser Fireball, Fireball, Smokescreen, Combustion, Chain Lightening, Lesser Electric Ball, Raise Earth, Earthquake, Lesser Water blast, Water blast, Whirlwind, Cyclone, Fog, Winds Quickness, Hailstones, Flash freeze, Ultimate Healing, Ultimate Heal friend, Resurrection, Ultimate Raise Dead, Greater Shadow Ball, Silence, Deafen, Blind
Personality: Brave, Nurturing, Caring, defensive of elves (Does not tolerate the insulting of elves or joking about them), quite, keeps to self
Mount: Snow white Evalian stallion

Backstory: Born in Forlathis in Everwood in the year 1000 B.A at that end of the Civil war he was the first son of the first Evalian Prime Minister and the daughter of the dethroned king. He is the last living descendent of the royal bloodline of Evalia and seen as the heart of both the Republic and the Kingdom.

Kieran grew up in a new Age of Change with his mother teaching him the bow and his father teaching him dual swordsmanship and hiring him a tutor to teach him some of the magics. He was one of the captains sent to the lands now known at Kyrinus to secure it for colonization, he landed in what is now Vlaris and set up a camp before setting sail south and landing in Cthulis.

When the Dwarves rose Kieran was part of a scout unit in the Evalian military which was sent directly from Kyrinus. When the group arrived they were met by a large group of heavily armored men of small stature but large size. They approached the men who became aggressive and urged the elves back. One of Kierans men, an arrogant and loudmouthed man pulled his bow and shot at one of them setting the Dwarves off. The two groups fought with Kieran being forces to use his magics to fend of the Dwarves, though he lost all of his men. He fled back to Kyrinus and told the colonial governor what had transpired.

A few days later in Cthulis the Dwarves invaded and quickly captured the city in retaliation for the attack before a resistance led by Kieran organized and retook the city long enough for him and some men to sail back to Everwood. There they informed the government of what happened and then learned that the Sadion colony of Estru was also invaded, war was declared and Kieran began rallying the army behind him.

The war lasted 228 years and Kieran was part of every minute of it, from the sieges of Cthulis and Estru City to the fall and recapture of Ikrarion which was granted to Everwood by Sadire in return for their aid in the war. At the end of the war Kieran was distraught, he spent his entire life training to protect his people and in the end his lack of control over his men launched his people into an over 200 year war. Kieran fled to Vlaris and remained there for 100 years expanding his knowledge of magic and other skills and working many jobs under a fake name. In 500 A.A Kyrinus declared independence from Everwood and declared war at the same time Estru did against Sadire.

Kieran gathered his gear and fought his way through the streets, collecting some Karthinians, Estrusians, Akarians, Evalians and Sadire men and their families that did not wish to partake in the rebellions. The group fought their way to the docks and stole a large ship and set sail for Everwood. The wars were very short but the colonies even though defeated were both granted independence. Some of the families returned home and those men without families remained with Kieran and became the Rangers of Larius working mainly for the Evalian government. In time the non-Elves in the company died and some of the elves left. There were 45 people including Kieran in the company now, all elves of different specialties and ancestries. It was 600 A.A and Sadire was once again at war with Estru and quickly put them down. For the next 742 years Kieran led the Rangers across the continent, even venturing into the Akarian underground.

Kieran is personal friends of Lord Eric Vornwolf and Emperor Cathius Akaria with ties in the Evalian Government, and Karthinian Council. The Rangers number in the five hundreds and take jobs all over Larius. He awoke to a messenger bearing a letter with the seal of Akaria and Estru. The letter told him of the exploration fleet heading west and the vast gold to be offered to him and his people. He leaves his tent and organizes his men, they march for Castle LuCain.
Faction Name: Rangers of Larius
Faction Location: Larius
Faction Leader: Kieran Pelleas
Faction Ranks:
Initiate
Apprentice
Ranger
Ranger Sergeant
Ranger Lieutenant
Grand Ranger
Ranger of Evalia

Faction History/Bio: Started by Kieran Pelleas almost 1000 years ago the Rangers consist of and only accept elves of differing specialties for differing jobs. The Rangers work for any and all as long as the job is morally acceptable, though they mostly work for Akaria and Southern Estru and sometimes the Evalian Republics.
Why should we accept this Faction: Guilds are needed
What benefits will this Faction Bring: Hireable guild of around 500 elves, gives elves a guild to join.

KIRA-S06.title: The History of  Sadion (Sadire Humans)
paragraphs: The story of Sadion began in 2500 B.A, 125 years after the Great ones attacked the small folk of stone. The Great ones were the ancestors of the Sadire's of Sadion. They were originally located in modern day Stone Hill. They used caves as homes and dug tunnels to mine for ore. One day they could find no more ore in their mines so they gathered their things and set off for a distant land located in modern day Sadion.

When they reached their destination they immediately began to build cities and then castles. After 2000 they had 8 cities and one great capital known as Bay Watch. Bay Watch was led by a king named Grad Vollan. Grad was a military genius and never lost a battle in his life. He soon conquered all of Sadion and established a group known as the Legion of Valiance. The Legion was made to keep peace of Bay Watch and all of Sadion.

Shortly after the Legion was established King Vollan was assassinated on the day of the birth of his son, San Vollan. After his father’s assassination San was named future king of Sadion. He would be crowned when he turned age 15 making him the youngest king in Sadion history. San was also the first king to build a Navy and a Hunter corp (a group of bounty hunters that hunt down the most dangerous criminals on the continent). He lived for 107 years and by the time of his death he was known as the greatest Sadion king to ever live.

The Sadire sent people to their old lands of Estru and built small cities there while Elvanian sent people across the water to Kyrinus where they settled. In 80 A.A the Dwarves attacked the Estru Protectorate and the Kyrinus Dominion bringing the infuriated king Dole Vollan of Sadire and the Prime Minister of the Evalian in on the side of their respective colonies. The war was hard fought for thirty years until the Dwarves created new war machines and began pushing deep into the colonial lands in 110 A.A.

For the next ninety years the humans and the elves fought as hard as they could to hold off the Dwarven invasion but it was futile and soon Estru had but a city on the border of Everwood and Kyrinus had one on their land border off the mainland with Sadion.

Dole soon learned that the elves were being attacked also. He quickly made an alliance between man and elf in 200 A.A. Dole was known as one of the great kings of Sadion and will always be remembered in history.

In 500 A.A the colonies were angry that they didn’t recive compensation in the peace with the dwarves a hundred years ago and together rebelled against their masters but were put down and allowed independence.

The alliance between them lasted until the king Kali Vollan was on the throne in the year 600 A.A when the armies of Estrusian attempted to invade Sadion. King Kali protected the border and then when all of the Estrusian troops were gone he invaded their homeland and crippled their army leaving the country defenseless. After the war, Sadion doubled the defenses and did not give their trust to any country so easily. They presented Estrusians as an example to anyone that would try to attack them. No other army has tried to invade Sadion because of the example made by King Kali.
The current king of Sadion is Erik Vollan along with his son Alek Vollan. King Erik is known as the best king since San and is loved by his people and other rulers across the continent.

KIRA-S07.title: The History of Akaria (Akarian Dwarves)
paragraphs: The Akarian Dwarves of Iron hill sprung from the ground so long ago it has been lost to history. What is known is that over four thousand years ago in what is known as 3000 B.A or Before Assent the Dwarves became united and now shared a common history and with ways to write began recorded history. In the years before this though, the Dwarves were broken into many, many clans spread throughout the underground of what is known today as Iron Hill. The leader of Clan Akarian known as Barvaris Akarian was a great diplomat, and more so a great general. Akarian united the smaller clans under his banner and soon he stood chief of the largest of them. He swept across the Dwarven roads underground bringing as many clans together with peace as he could, those that did not follow were destroyed. Soon he controlled all the underground empire which became known as Akaria and led them through a golden age with scholars of the differing clans working together to bring great advances and their warriors forming a formidable army mixing their historic ways of combat. Recorded History starts at 3000 B.A at the founding of the Akarian Empire and the creation of the first tablet to record words on to be stored for study of history. The Dwarves dreamed to expand their empire and expand they did, further than they believed possible.

The first three hundred years after the formation of the empire was filled with expansion and technological marvels coming to existence. The wheel giving transportation speed and ease, wagons were built and used to transport materials across the empire, new weapons saw predators easily put down with the dwarves becoming the prime hunter of the underground. After a quite three centuries the Dwarves grew restless but soon in the year 2625 B.A their anger against each other was turned outward for miners breached wall into tunnels that were not their own. Following these tunnels the Akarian military found another race they called them the Karthi, they were tall and well-built and looked nothing of the Dwarves… they were aggressive and attack the Dwarves on sight believing them monsters from the deep. The Dwarves drove the Karthi back but there always seemed to be more coming at them eventually the dwarves brought down the tunnel leading to where the Karthi came from sealing the people apart. The Akarians spread like a wild fire finding Dwarven nations in the underground and assimilating them, peacefully or through war. For a thousand years after their encounter with the Karthi the Dwarves expanded in peace and war growing more technologically advanced.The year is 1700 B.A and the Akarians discovered a mixture that fizzes and when in great amount explodes two hundred years prior. Using well placed supports and this mixture they called Golems flame after the extreme amount of heat required to make their statues of kings, the golems. The Dwarves spread even quicker until they reach an issue… a blue liquid lays at the end of a tunnel they call it water. The water prevents the Dwarves from expanding in all but one way, the lair of the Karthi. The Arkarians take their Golems Flame and march with a massive army to the tunnel sealed a thousand years hence. They spend years readying their military bringing new ways to kill and new weapons but other advances come as well in science and medicine. Eventually the Dwarves reopen the tunnels and charge through until they are met by nothing, whispers in the tunnels myths formed by the ancestors to scare the young. They continue to expand through the new stone building their empire. At this time the Dwarves were of many cities with small populations but in 1000 B.A Emperor Karcius Akarian sought to condense the empire. Small cities that were in non-strategic places were torn down and massive stone cities were erected where thousands of Dwarves would live with a new capital built at the center of the empire where all roads would lead to, this was Karkaria. From 573 puny cities with a few hundred Dwarves each to 9 massive cities and one city to rival them all with thousands and thousands of Dwarves each.

The year is 200 B.A and the Dwarves have been blocked from expansion all around, too scared to go down that they may fall to lava and unable to progress around them even with Golems fire due to impassible stone or water the Dwarves look up to build their cities higher. For the next 200 years the Dwarves slowly build higher and higher not knowing how high they are able to go before the stone falls upon them. On the last day of the year they breached the stone and found a blinding light a circle of energy hot to the skin and harsh on the eyes. Surrounding them was a soft white material they called Snyli which translates to snow in the new tongue these mountains offered new opportunity and perspective. The Dwarves changed their calendar starting from 0 they began counting up with the new A.A or After Ascension calendar calling the old years B.A or Before Ascension.

Dwarves now find new uses for old inventions and soon reach new heights in technology with new materials for experimentation. The creation of the Kartac or Gun in the new tongue a weapon used at long range utilizing a refined version of Golems flame called Golfla or in the new tongue Gun Powder allowed hunting the animals in the snowy mountains. The Dwarves send our scouts to search for more land where they encounter other creatures who call their race the Humans and the Elves and wage war upon them for resources they hold. The Dwarves gained much land in 110 A.A almost bringing the Elves to the east to heel along with the Humans to the north but then the two allied and with a combined army in the north they swept down reclaiming much of the Human land before sending another combined army east to take the lands of the Elves back. In 400 A.A peace was signed and the Dwarves began building Frikori or Factories in the new tongue and produced many wares that were sold across the Elven and Human lands. In 600 A.A the Dwarves watched as the Humans and Elves fought their own kind and split into the Human Sadire of Sadion and the Estrusians of Estru and the Elven Evalian of Everwood and Karthinian of Kyrinus.

From 600 A.A to 1342, present day the Dwarves have kept a unstable peace with the Elven and Human nations watching their many petty squabbles while they continued to advance in technology with 10 underground cities and 5 above ground cities the Dwarves boast the largest population, most cities and most advanced and rich people with the largest military.

KIRA-S08.title: The History of Everwood (Evalian Elves)
paragraphs: The story of the Evalian Elves of Everwood is shrouded in mystery. Everwood was once covered in Elven tribes with the Sea Elves being the most magical, the elves of the plains being the most numerous, the forest elves were the fastest and the mountain elves the largest and strongest yet least numerous due to the small number of mountains. Before recorded history started for the Evalian the Sea and Plain elves allied while the Mountain and Tree elves allied and formed twin nations Evalia and Woadaris. Even though they were primitive they were able to hold together as nations but soon war erupted between them and for years they fought. Until a splinter group of all four races arose and attacked both sides bringing them to heel and forming Evermore and thus recorded history started. In the year 2791 the elven nation was strong and advancing rapidly but they paid no attention to medicine due to their advanced healing attributes. This proved to be the downfall of the strongest nation in Larius for in 2500 B.A the primitive Sadire humans traversed the Elvalian lands bringing disease but not war. These diseases proved too much for the elves and they were unable to naturally combat it and soon their numbers dwindled, they fought themselves for the little medicine they had, destroying much of their technology. For five hundred years they fought each other reducing themselves back in technology to being little better than the humans were at the time.

By 2000 B.A the Evalians were rising back up with the humans close behind settled to their east in what they call Sadion. The nations opened trade in 1998 B.A when the Sadire tribes united but remained relatively neutral towards each other. In 1010 B.A Civil war ravaged Everwood with the rebels winning the war they executed King Carius and moved the capital from Tethris to Evalia and proclaimed a republic where ten representatives from every city with the capital having an eleventh and five from every village would meet four times a year to discuss national decisions. The government was made up of a total 256 representatives. The Grand Republic of Evalia spent the next one thousand and ten years in absolute peace, then word spread of the Ascension of the Dwarves. On the final day of the year, the Dwarves rose from the ground and for the next eighty years the Elven republic and the Sadire kingdom sat watching them. The Sadire sent people to their old lands of Estru and built small cities there while Elvania sent people across the water to Kyrinus where they settled.

In 80 A.A the Dwarves attacked the Estru Protectorate and Kyrinus Dominion bringing the Sadire and the Evalians in on the side of their respective colonies. The war was hard fought for thirty years until the Dwarves created new war machines and began pushing deep into the colonial lands in 110 A.A. For the next ninety years the humans and the elves fought as hard as they could to hold off the Dwarven invasion, but it was futile and soon Estru had but a city on the border of Everwood and Kyrinus had one on an island off the mainland bordered with the Sadire. The nations saw that separately they barley put up a fight and in a last-ditch effort they allied.

In 200 A.A, the combined Evalian and Sadire army marched through Estru retaking all but a small chunk of land from the dwarves by 289 A.A. For the next three years the army fought off the Dwarven counter advance until one day they didn’t attack, and word reached them that they were marching to destroy Kyrinus and the army set sail. Arriving at the besieged Kyrinus city the Evalian-Saidre army fought off the Dwarven army and sailed back for the mainland where they pushed the Dwarves back until only a small chuck of Kyrinus remaining occupied in 399 A.A. For the next year the nations fought but even with their combined power the Elves and Humans couldn’t breach the Dwarven defenses and in 400 A.A peace was signed with the small, occupied land being gifted to the Dwarves in peace and the Dwarves gave the Sadire and Evalian large sums of Kathis coins. This peace deal angered the Estrusians and Karthinians who got nothing in the deal and the two allied and declared war on their weakened masters in 500 A.A. Even though they were weak the mother nations put their colonies down, but seeing that they were not loved they gave the two independency. In 600 A.A the Evalians watched as the Estrusians invaded Sadire and were utterly crushed by their former masters and their technology destroyed. For the past 742 years the Evalians have seen peace and have brought their technological advancements to near Dwarven levels.

KIRA-S09.title: The History of Kyrinus (Karthinian Elves)
paragraphs: The Elves of Kyrinus are known as the Karthinians but this was not always so. The Karthinians were once a colony of the Evalian Elves of Everwood founded in 40 A.A. In 80 A.A the Dwarves invaded Kyrinus and Estru drawing the Evalians and Sadire into the war in defense of their colonies. The war ended in 400 A.A after a combined Human-Elf force retook Estru and Kyrinus from the Dwarves and peace was signed. In 500 A.A the Karthinians had grown even angrier after a hundred years with no compensation after the end of the Dwarven war in 400 A.A they rebelled alongside the Estrusians from their masters and even though they were both utterly defeated by their overlords they were both granted independence.

Kyrinus and Estru continued as stalwart allies until the Estru war against Sadion when the Karthinians realized the war was pointless and didn’t join. The Karthinians brokered with their former overlords a new trade agreement. For over 700 years the relations between the two Elven nations have blossomed and they currently have a Non-Aggression pact.
